paper.title: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
paper.central_claim: Inducing workflows from a few demonstrations guides sparse-reward web exploration, trains a stronger DOMnet policy, achieves state-of-the-art task performance, handles longer real-world website tasks, and improves demonstration efficiency by over 100x relative to behavioral cloning.

provenance.actual_model_source: Environment explicitly reports gpt-6.1-sol; no model probing performed.

evidence.quote:
Sampled episodes from the workflow policy that receive a positive reward
are stored in a replay buffer
evidence.support_explanation: Reward selects explorer rollouts for later neural training, not reusable test-time skills.

evidence.quote:
Its decisions
only depend on the selected demonstration and the current time
evidence.support_explanation: Workflow selection is state-blind; evaluating selected constraints still uses the current DOM.

evidence.quote:
Both updates use A2C, the synchronous version of the advantage actor-critic
algorithm
evidence.support_explanation: Same neural policy trained from on-policy and successful replay; actor-critic is not an independent success judge.

evidence.quote: we used Amazon Mechanical Turk to collect 10 demonstrations
evidence.support_explanation: Demonstration budget per compatible task; says nothing about equal interaction budgets.
Matched DOMnet BC+RL 0 versus WGE 84, with workflow-only 43, on an explicitly longer task.
Clear counterexample to closing web-task completion generally.

evidence.quote:
we report the test success rate at the time step where
the success rate on a validation set reaches its maximum.
evidence.support_explanation: Validation selects checkpoint; reported metric is on test episodes, not training reward.

evidence.quote:
During training, the workflow policy π w \pi_{\mathrm{w}} receives states with both the structured goal
and the natural language utterance generated from a random template,
while the neural policy π n \pi_{\mathrm{n}} receives only the utterance.
evidence.support_explanation: Privileged structured input for training explorer, not deployment neural policy.

evidence.quote:
replaced the server backend with
a surrogate JavaScript function, and clamped the environment date to March 1, 2017.
evidence.support_explanation: Alaska is instrumented surrogate, not live airline service.

evidence.quote:
our approach, using only 1 demonstration, achieves an average reward of 0.97,
compared to their best result of 0.57, which uses around 80 demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: Alaska reward comparison is fractional field correctness, not binary task completion.

evidence.quote:
This corresponds to an over 100x sample
efficiency improvement of our method over behavioral cloning in terms of the
number of demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: Efficiency unit is demonstrations on selected hard tasks, not compute or environment interactions.

signatures.information: Expert state-action demonstrations and structured goal keys; current DOM only when applying a sampled constraint.
signatures.operation: Enumerate consistent Click/Type constraint steps plus shortcuts; select demonstration by goal keys, sample learned step distribution, then sample satisfying action. REINFORCE uses terminal return.
signatures.conditions: Click/type leaf DOM; workflow grammar must cover successful behavior.
signatures.selection_rule: Accept positive-reward episodes into replay; unsuccessful ones do not enter replay.
signatures.persistence: Workflow probability parameters and successful-rollout buffer.
signatures.later_use: A2C neural policy consumes replay, then executes state-dependent DOMnet at test.
signatures.claimed_effect: Discover reward without BC overfitting few demonstrations.
signatures.failure_boundary: State-blind workflow selection cannot adapt layouts or synonyms; grammar and demo coverage limit reachable behavior.

signatures.information: Goal plus DOM attributes, spatial 30px relations and tree ancestors; not screenshot-only.
signatures.operation: Aggregate spatial and ancestor-neighbor features; attend to goal and DOM; predict click/type and value; train on/off-policy A2C.
signatures.conditions: Structured DOM and compatible leaf action space; type content from goal.
signatures.feedback: Sparse execution reward and positive replay.
signatures.selection_data: Sparse execution reward and positive replay.
signatures.persistence: Learned network weights; no test-time skill library or self-modifying code.
signatures.claimed_effect: Generalize better than literal workflow-only and BC warm-start.
signatures.failure_boundary: Only 40 compatible tasks; all-tweet task remains 0, transfer task not improved; Alaska is a clone.

gap.author_gap: Sparse terminal rewards defeat random exploration, while a few behavioral-cloning demonstrations overfit superficial actions.
gap.checked_gap: Matched DOMnet comparison and reported early-submit/cycling failures support a concrete 2018 exploration bottleneck. Independent nearest-original verification is incomplete, so absolute novelty is not asserted.

gap.residue: Need useful broad exploration neighborhoods, not only state imitation of ten demonstrations.
gap.stakes: Web interaction has combinatorial action choices and sparse outcomes.
gap.method_response: Infer executable action neighborhoods from demonstrations, optimize workflow choices using task return, retain successes, and distill into state-dependent DOM policy.
gap.remaining_gap: Limited compatible action space, state-blind explorer, no independent-site transfer, no live Alaska backend evidence.
unresolved: Closest historical originals are not in common fixed source bundle; novelty comparison remains author-attributed.
Plot-level numerical values and source HTML version correspondence not independently verified.
gap.current_relevance: Historical example of demonstration-guided sparse-reward exploration; do not confuse it with later workflow-memory retrieval. Later developments were not used to invalidate the 2018 gap.

success_failure_checks.reason: Constraint grammar and shortcuts define candidates.

matches.reason: Primary is learned distribution over workflow configurations; no exact child because C22 automated architecture/supernet collapse is not what this system claims.

tactic_steps_checked: Spatial threshold and tree-neighbor pooling fix relation-specific neighborhoods.

success_failure_checks.reason: Spatial and DOM-ancestor neighborhoods are explicit.
Construction captures neighbors operationally; comparison to Shi17 also changes observation/architecture, not clean topology ablation.

matches.reason: DOMnet encodes relational wiring, matching C13 parent, not C16 symmetry; supportive architecture does not explain all WGE improvement.

rs_pattern.reason: Learned workflow distribution is the main operational correspondence; relational DOMnet is supporting. Exact child C22 is deliberately not assigned.
rs_pattern.executes_pattern: partial: learns probabilities over executable discrete workflows; supportive relational topology is constructed.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: scoped: substantially improves compatible sparse-reward tasks, not general web automation.

condition_checks.condition: Sparse executable terminal reward and successful replay
condition_checks.reason: REINFORCE explorer and A2C neural policy reuse rewarded episodes.
No mixed TD/MC instruction critics, KL recipe or perplexity filtering; map only sparse RL/value/replay common operations.
Click/type leaf DOM element IDs, rather than pixel-coordinate detection.
Only compatible 40 tasks retained; unsupported action modes excluded.

unassigned: Demonstration-constrained exploratory workflow induction is not identical to persistent test-time workflow retrieval.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Return-optimized workflow sampler supplies successful episodes to A2C replay.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_differences: Explorer distribution is not a modern KL/PRM/RL recipe; source of proposals is demonstrations, not generated tasks.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Use known spatial/DOM relations over addressable elements.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_differences: No screenshot marks or pixel localization, no formal symmetry certificate.
